expirySemantics.rationale: fail-closed: every ambiguity resolves to unknown, never to a negative, so an expired observation can never move a membership

failClosedBoundary: timestamp in the future -> stale -> unknown
observation older than its tolerance -> stale -> unknown
stored verdict api_unavailable/api_error -> unknown (never a negative)

noRouteApproximation.rationale: the verdict vocabulary has exactly one producer for a real negative: the upstream routing service; an API-free heuristic can only ever produce 'probably no path', which is a different statement

decision.producerPrecedence: usdG valuation is a value/economy judgement and is NOT admissible as a depth or capacity signal (R-02/R-03/R-04 stand); depth remains on-chain tick liquidity

ttl.rationale: membership is a coarse fact about the token's place in the venue routing graph and changes slowly; magnitude is a market observation used for capacity banding and changes quickly
